text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, after finishing training
with Satono Crown—

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... The crowd didn't get into it again.
What are we doing wrong with our magic...?

text_block_list.name: Lively Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Even after practicing so hard for the show...
...Maybe I just don't have the talent.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You look pretty serious...
Why don't you tell me what's on your mind?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The two had apparently been agonizing over it, as the moment Satono Crown spoke up, their words poured out like a broken dam.

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We love magic, so...
we performed on the street, but
the crowd didn't get into it at all...

text_block_list.name: Lively Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"You were totally hopeless the other day too, right?
...Here, look, this is the video from back then."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh, your magic technique is flawless!
Though... it's true, not many people are stopping to watch.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, we need to find ways to get people to watch the magic. If we re-examine things starting from the preparation stage, we should be able to improve!

text_block_list.name: Lively Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
!! Really?!
What kind of preparations should I make?!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Please...!
We want more and more people
to see our magic!
choice_data_list: Crown, do you think you can help her?
Crown, do you think you can help her?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Leave it to me! I'll give you my full support.
You lend a hand too, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: First, publicity to draw in a crowd. It's a classic, but let's order some flyers.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
The stage for the magic show is in the park, so—
A warm and pop design would be lovely!
choice_data_list: What does the location have to do with the flyers?
Does the location have anything to do with the flyers?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Of course! With an approachable design,
we can target families visiting the park.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: We can narrow down our program to suit our target, so it's killing two birds with one stone!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Next is setting up the stage.
To present it effectively—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hey, is there a black cloth anywhere around here?
Preferably a big one.
choice_data_list: If you need poster paper, there's some in the Trainer's office.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Ngam sai, let's use that!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, looking good!
Just as I thought, it matches the lighting perfectly.

text_block_list.name: Lively Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oooh... With this,
I can get them to focus on the magic!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
We should also make some standing signs.
Let's really highlight the duo's signature colors!
choice_data_list: It may be tedious, but this kind of preparation is important.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's right! Magic starts right from thinking about who you're showing it to, how to present it, and getting everything prepared!

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"Our way of doing things wasn't enough...
We need to think more about what the customers need!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
There should still be plenty we can do.
For example, let's see—

text_block_list.name: Lively Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, I just had a great idea!
How about you make a guest appearance!?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Huh, are you sure?
Even though it was supposed to be a stage for just the two of you.
choice_data_list: I think it'd be even more exciting if you were in it.
I think it'll be even more exciting if you enter.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Oh?
—Well, hearing you say that,
I have no choice but to give it my all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Get your hopes up!
I'll get the whole park rocking!
choice_data_list: I'm expecting an amazing magic trick full of power!
I want to see thrilling, mind-blowing magic!
Shall we take our time and work it out carefully without rushing?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
That sounds interesting!
I'll make sure to polish it to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the magic show. Thanks to the promotions,
many families came to watch.
It's almost time for Satono Crown's turn!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, I'm super strong!
I can lift anything, no matter how heavy it is!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For instance, take this dumbbell here!
Just like this!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: That's totally normal~~!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see! Then what if
big sis gets on right here~~~?

text_block_list.name: Lively Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Waaaa~~!?
You lifted me up too--!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Ooooooohーーー!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I can handle way more weight than this!
Stack on one more big sis~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown's magic was a huge hit,
and the show was a great success!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From the next day on, Satono Crown began
preparing the magic tricks she would show off, but—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, no good. I can't show it yet.
I have to fix the finer details even more...!

text_block_list.name: Lively Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
We've gotta prepare properly, right!
Let's practice until we're totally satisfied!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you!
Let us strive for peak condition...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown and the others decided to focus on their preparations,
putting off the magic show for the time being!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great!
I'll give it some careful thought!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day of the magic show. Thanks to the promotions,
many families came to watch.
It's almost time for Satono Crown's turn!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Everyone!
The truth is, I am no ordinary Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm a wizard who can control the Earth!
And as proof—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: "Look! Seesaws have vanished from the Earth!"

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh~~!?
Why, whyyy~~!?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu, next is—
let's take out me!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text:
Wawaaa~~!?
Big sis disappeared!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Now then, I wonder where I am~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The children went wild over Satono Crown's magic.
The show was a massive success!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Since children will be watching,
finding the right balance of impact is rather tricky...

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Could you give me some time to think it over? If I come up with a good idea, I'd love to make an appearance!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To perfect her new magic trick,
Satono Crown devoted herself
to preparation!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see, that's true too.
Panicking won't lead to any good ideas.

text_block_list.name: Quiet Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Understood.
For now, we'll do our best on our own!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry.
But I'll definitely come watch the real race!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Taking time to properly brainstorm magic tricks,
the performance in the show was put on hold!
